result.stdout:
RazorFmt - a standalone Razor / Blazor formatter

Usage: razorfmt [options] [file-or-directory ...]
  With no path, reads from stdin and writes to stdout.
  Directories are scanned recursively for .razor and .cshtml files (requires --write or --check).

Options:
  -w, --write            Rewrite changed files in place.
  -c, --check            Exit 1 if a file would change; write nothing.
  -d, --diff             Print a unified diff; write nothing.
      --indent-size <N>  Override .editorconfig indent_size (default 4).
      --tabs             Override .editorconfig indent_style with tabs.
      --no-csharp        Do not run Roslyn over @code / @functions bodies.
      --keep-blanks      Do not collapse runs of blank lines.
      --split-tags       Put adjacent tags on separate lines (may add inline whitespace).
      --no-split-tags    Disable split_tags from .editorconfig.
      --wrap-attributes  Put each attribute of a long tag on its own line.
      --no-wrap-attributes  Disable wrap_attributes from .editorconfig.
      --max-line-length <N>  Wrap tags longer than N columns (default 120).
      --split-code       Reflow one-line C# statements and methods.
      --no-split-code    Disable split_code from .editorconfig.
  -h, --help             Show this help.
      --version          Show the version.
